name: Happy Path — CDD Periodic Review (Corporate)
description: Scheduled CDD review triggered for standard-risk corporate client. Documents collected within 14 days. Screening clear. Risk rating unchanged. Compliance Officer records continue decision. CddReviewCompleted published. Next review scheduled.

steps.action: Scheduled job: review_due_date reached for client. Create CddReviewCase (status=triggered).
Publish CddReviewTriggered (EVT-142)
Consume EVT-142 → Pre-load KycAssessment for analyst
Consume EVT-142 → Write trigger audit record
GET /cdd-reviews?status=triggered → review queue → assign to analyst
PATCH /cdd-reviews/{review_id} {assigned_to: PER-058}
Send document request to corporate client via secure portal
PATCH /cdd-reviews/{review_id} {status: documents_requested}
Upload documents via secure portal (certificate of incorporation, accounts, UBO declarations)
Verify documents → update UBO structure → PATCH /cdd-reviews/{review_id} {documents_received, ubo_structure}
Run identity verification on UBOs (internal call within CAP-005)
Verification result: all UBOs verified
Run sanctions screening, PEP screening, adverse media check on all UBOs and corporate entity
Screening results: sanctions_hit=false, pep_match=false, risk_rating=medium (unchanged)
Update CddReviewCase {screening_results, risk_rating: medium, risk_rating_changed: false, status: risk_assessed}
Review screening results → POST /cdd-reviews/{review_id}/decision {review_decision: continue, rationale, next_review_date}
POST /cdd-reviews/{review_id}/decision {review_decision: continue, decision_rationale, next_review_date}
Publish CddReviewCompleted (EVT-146) {review_decision: continue, risk_rating: medium, next_review_date}
Consume EVT-146 → Update KycAssessment: last_reviewed_at, next_review_date
Consume EVT-146 → Update internal client record: cdd_status=current
Consume EVT-146 → Write immutable closure audit record (7-year retention)
